name: X API
tagline: Programmatic posts, users, trends, DMs, media, and social data.
shortDescription: X API provides paid access to posts, users, search, media upload, DMs, spaces, lists, and trends.
agentSummary: Agents can publish and read social data, but pricing, access levels, and policy compliance make it less automatic.
bestFor: Social publishing, monitoring public conversations, and account workflow automation.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Posting, DMs, compliance, and changing API access tiers require human review. Posting, moderation, DMs, paid campaigns, platform policy, brand voice, and account reputation should stay human-reviewed for public or customer-facing actions. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging. Account setup or elevated access may require vendor, admin, or compliance approval before an agent can operate independently.
pricingSummary: Public pay-per-use and enterprise API plans; access differs by endpoint.
authModel: OAuth 1.0a, OAuth 2.0, bearer tokens, app/user permissions.
accountCreation: Developer account setup and paid access are required for many workflows.
browserSupport: Developer portal and product UI are important for app setup and review.
